status: Thresholds and evaluation design written before outcome computation; blind to Brief 001 and prior outputs

indicators.claims_rise_20pct: 4-week ICSA average / minimum of its last 52 weekly averages - 1 >= 0.20; sampled last weekly observation each month
indicators.sahm_050: SAHMREALTIME >= 0.50 percentage points; one calendar month availability lag
indicators.curve_inverted: monthly GS10 - TB3MS < 0 percentage points; one month availability lag
indicators.baa_level_300: last BAA10Y observation in month >= 3.00 percentage points
indicators.baa_widening_100: last BAA10Y observation in month minus value 3 calendar months earlier >= 1.00 percentage point
indicators.nfci_positive: last NFCI observation in month > 0; one month conservative availability lag
indicators.inflation_surge: calendar CPIAUCSL YoY >= 4.0% and YoY minus YoY 12 calendar months earlier >= 2.0 percentage points; one month availability lag
indicators.inflation_400: calendar CPIAUCSL YoY >= 4.0%; one month availability lag; diagnostic/context

threshold_rationale: Round economic levels and published Sahm 0.5 / NFCI 0 / curve inversion conventions; no threshold optimization. BAA thresholds are policy-design priors, not validated economic constants.
additional_horizon: Curve inversion also evaluated at 24 months, preselected for long-cycle lead time

events.recession_onset: USREC rises from 0 to 1 in strictly next 1..h months; exclude signal months already in recession
events.recession_present_or_onset: USREC is 1 in signal month or next 1..h months; explicitly diagnostic, not predictive
events.equity_entry_loss_20: minimum next 1..h monthly-average Shiller SP500 / signal-month price - 1 <= -20%; price only, not total return
events.equity_peak_drawdown_20: a running monthly-average Shiller SP500 peak since signal month loses >=20% before horizon; price only; peak reset at signal month
events.inflation_onset_400: calendar CPI YoY first rises to >=4% in strictly next 1..h months; exclude already >=4% at signal date (underlying observation timeline)
events.credit_onset_300: month-last BAA10Y first rises to >=3pp in strictly next 1..h months; exclude already >=3pp

alarm_episodes: Threshold false->true crossings, with accepted crossings at least h months apart; first evaluable observation excluded if already alarmed. Event-ineligible crossings excluded before declustering. Leads measured to first outcome month.
false_alarm_fraction: FP / (TP+FP) on eligible matured declustered alarm episodes; this is not classical FPR
classical_fpr: Monthly threshold-positive nonevent observations / all eligible matured nonevent observations, FP/(FP+TN); overlapping months descriptive, not independent trials
split: holdout signal dates >=2000-01-31; training only signal dates with outcome window ending <=1999-12-31; no fitting on either split
maturity: Keep rows only if every horizon month exists for each outcome; current unresolved alarms never called false
publication: Monthly data lagged one month for Sahm, curve, CPI and NFCI. Claims week-ending series and BAA use last monthly observation; exact within-month release dates unavailable. This is revised-data pseudo-out-of-sample, not a real-time vintage backtest.
uncertainty: Report episode n, hits, false alarms, Wilson 95% interval, median/min/max lead; report monthly unconditional event rate and diagnostic redundancy. Low effective n precludes optimized triggers or trading recommendations.
